name: com.ezg.ezgkit
description: One-window Unity Editor setup kit that walks a new project through its per-project configuration in the order it must happen. Sidebar splits into two groups: Setup Ezg and Publishers (one tab per SDK set — Ezg in-house default, Neptune CPI test, SayGame placeholder — showing required vs installed vs extra SDKs and which IDs to change where, with a one-click Switch that caches and removes extra SDKs, installs missing ones, writes publisher IDs and toggles EZG_SDK_* defines; add a profile class to add a publisher). Setup Ezg ships: Marketing (pull a Google Sheet of store/ads identifiers and write them into PlayerSettings, AdsConfig, AppLovinSettings, FacebookSettings, AndroidManifest and GameConstant.cs) and Firebase (pick a service-account .json, provision the Android + iOS apps, then download google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist) and Readiness (read-only Ready / Warning / Error board for IAP SKUs, Firebase config, ads/attribution SDK keys and store/build settings, with a copy-for-PM text report). Opening the window only ever reads; every write sits behind an explicit button. Also ships the shared EzgKitStyles / SetupGui drawing toolkit and the IEzgKitPage contract so a project can add its own setup tab.
